title: Lakshmi Ganapathi Traders vs Sri Venkateswara Agencies
nature: suit for recovery of money on unpaid invoices
one_line_summary: Recovery of Rs. 14,62,000 on 23 unpaid invoices for hardware supplied in 2019-20.
court: Court of the IV Additional Chief Judge, City Civil Court, Hyderabad

hearings.order_sheet: DW1 present. Partly cross-examined by counsel for plaintiff. Call on 23.04.2025.
hearings.note: Lakshmi Ganapathi (OS 1043/21) - DW1 is their accountant, not the proprietor. Admitted 17 of 23 invoices bear their shop stamp. Denied the other 6. Need the delivery challans for those 6 - ask Srinivas garu.

action_items.task: collect delivery challans for 6 disputed invoices from client

hearings.outcome: DW1 cross concluded; defendants' evidence closed
hearings.order_sheet: DW1 further cross-examined and discharged. Defendants' evidence closed. For arguments, call on 16.07.2025.
hearings.note: Lakshmi Ganapathi - DW1 done. Confronted with the 6 challans, he said 'I cannot say'. Good enough. Their evidence closed. Now arguments. Prepare a table of invoice / challan / exhibit numbers for the judge.

hearings.outcome: Adjournment sought by defendants' counsel citing illness
hearings.order_sheet: Counsel for defendant absent; memo filed stating counsel is unwell. Adjourned to 24.09.2025.
hearings.note: Lakshmi Ganapathi - Achary 'unwell', memo through junior. First time in this case. Srinivas garu's accountant had come all the way from Siddipet.
hearings.adjournment_reason: counsel Sri Ch. Venugopal Achary unwell, memo filed

hearings.outcome: Adjournment sought by defendants' counsel (counsel held up in another court)
hearings.order_sheet: Counsel for defendant represents that he is held up in the High Court. Adjourned to 04.02.2026.
hearings.note: Lakshmi Ganapathi - this time Achary 'held up in HC'. 2nd adjournment from their side before IV ACJ. Judge looked at his register and said 'second time, counsel, please note'. I argued our part for 20 min anyway so the invoice table is on record.
hearings.adjournment_reason: counsel held up in the High Court

hearings.order_sheet: Arguments of counsel for plaintiff heard in part. Part-heard. Call on 11.02.2026.
hearings.note: Lakshmi Ganapathi - argued for almost the full day (this is why Tadepalli was not reached). Judge engaged a lot on the limitation of the 2019 invoices - I showed the acknowledgement letter Ex.A24 dated 12.08.2021 which extends limitation under S.18. He seemed satisfied. Our arguments nearly done.

hearings.outcome: Third adjournment sought by defendants' counsel citing illness; granted with costs of Rs. 3,000
hearings.order_sheet: Counsel for defendant absent. Memo filed that counsel is unwell. This is the third adjournment sought on behalf of the defendant. Adjournment granted subject to payment of costs of Rs. 3,000/- to the plaintiff before the next date. Call on 25.03.2026.
hearings.note: Lakshmi Ganapathi - Achary illness memo AGAIN, third time for their side. IV ACJ granted it but imposed Rs 3000 costs payable to our client before next date. Judge said 'the court's register shows this is the third request'. So he really does count. Remember this for Tadepalli.

action_items.task: confirm receipt of Rs. 3,000 costs from defendant

hearings.adjournment_reason: counsel Sri Ch. Venugopal Achary unwell, memo filed

hearings.outcome: Costs paid; defendants' arguments heard in part
hearings.order_sheet: Costs paid by DD. Arguments of counsel for defendant heard in part. Call on 08.07.2026.
hearings.note: Lakshmi Ganapathi - costs of 3000 paid by DD in court. Achary argued for 45 min, mostly that the 6 invoices are fabricated. Nothing new. He asked to continue next date.

hearings.outcome: Defendant's arguments continued; reply by plaintiff to follow
hearings.order_sheet: Arguments of counsel for defendant heard. For reply arguments of plaintiff, call on 05.10.2026.
hearings.note: Lakshmi Ganapathi - Achary finished. Our reply next date - short, 15 min, just the S.18 acknowledgement and the 6 challans. After that, judgment. Told Srinivas garu judgment may come by Diwali.
hearings.client_interaction: Told client judgment is likely by Diwali if reply arguments finish on next date.
